PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan for Exercise-Induced Asthma"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve endurance and general conditioning with asthma-safe progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to run-walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 2x3..5 minutes rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          jog 1x1.5..2 minutes rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Warm-up focus + brisk walk":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walk 3x4 minutes rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Easy jog progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walk 2x2 minutes rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Build aerobic base":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x3 minutes rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walk 1x2 minutes rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Interval intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
          walk 1x2 minutes rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Continuous jog practice":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 6x1 minute rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive steady run":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 4x3 minutes rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          walk 1x2 minutes rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Tempo-like effort":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x4 minutes rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Longer easy jog":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x6 minutes rpe 5 rest 240 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes

PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan for Exercise-Induced Asthma with Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve running performance with integrated asthma-safe strength program"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Intro to run-walk + foundation strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x1.5..2 minutes rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          bodyweight_exercise 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Mobility + strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Core + posterior chain":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          plank 3x20..40 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength foundation + run progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Core and hips":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds per side rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Total body basics":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lunge 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength + sustain pace":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Explosive-ish primers":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hangboard 2x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          kettlebell_swing 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Run + strength finisher":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5 minutes
